projects.title: MedVise – Self-Hosted Medical AI Assistant
projects.description: Sovereign clinical assistant grounding every answer in PubMed literature

media.caption: MedVise walkthrough — PubMed-grounded answers with inline citations
DICOM study viewer with per-organ segmentation

projects.fullDescription: End-of-studies project at Distamed. General-purpose chatbots hallucinate, rarely cite sources, and process data on foreign clouds — which Moroccan law 09-08 forbids for patient information. MedVise is a self-hosted medical conversational assistant that keeps every model, database and file on company hardware inside the country. It pairs the open-weight MedGemma model with a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that grounds each answer in PubMed literature and returns the supporting citations. It reaches users as a doctor web application, an admin console, and an embeddable widget integrated into Pratisoft.
features: PubMed-grounded answers streamed token by token with inline numbered citations
Self-hosted MedGemma served through vLLM — no patient data leaves the country
Medical image pipeline routing each attachment to its matching detection model
3D DICOM study viewer with per-organ TotalSegmentator segmentation, in 2D slices and rotatable volume
Answers in the language of the question over English-indexed evidence
B2C web app plus a B2B embeddable widget authenticating server-to-server
Admin console with per-account usage metering and an auditable access-window lifecycle
Three-stage auth chain over session JWTs and API tokens, with immediate revocation
Jenkins CI/CD into canary and stable pools, deployed entirely on company hardware

projects.title: CNSS FSE Integration for Pratisoft
projects.description: Electronic health-claim filing to Morocco's national social security system
projects.fullDescription: Morocco's CNSS mandated a move from paper medical claim forms to a digital FSE system (Feuille de Soins Électronique), which every practice management platform had to support to stay compliant. Pratisoft handled only private insurance at the time, so I built the CNSS module from scratch: the integration with the official CNSS FSE API and the interfaces doctors use to create, verify and publish electronic claims without leaving their existing workflow. Delivered solo across the full cycle — problem analysis, UML design, implementation, testing and validation.
features: Full FSE lifecycle — draft, verify, publish — with published documents immutable per CNSS rules
Direct integration with the official CNSS FSE API
Validation against CNSS requirements before a document is submitted
Status synchronisation between Pratisoft and the CNSS system
Patient visits, procedures and prescriptions folded automatically into each claim
Data model extended to carry procedures and prescriptions
Error handling that surfaces validation and submission failures to the doctor

projects.title: FireForge – API Client Library Generator
projects.description: CLI that turns a JSON API spec into a ready-to-use Python client library
projects.fullDescription: Distamed called several third-party APIs across its projects, with the HTTP calls hardcoded throughout each codebase — so a provider changing an endpoint meant hunting down and editing every call site. FireForge replaces that with a configuration-driven generator: a technical lead describes an API in JSON (base URL, authentication, endpoints, methods, parameters) and the CLI renders a complete Python client from Jinja2 templates. An API update becomes a config edit and a regeneration. First used for the CNSS integration in Pratisoft.
features: API specifications written in JSON and validated against a schema before generation
Jinja2 templates rendering complete Python client libraries
Class-level singleton authentication — one token shared across every module using a client
Removes the redundant login calls each module previously made on its own
Same generated library reusable across projects
An API version change becomes a config edit rather than a codebase-wide hunt

projects.title: Spree E-Commerce Migration to AWS
projects.description: Production-ready Spree store deployed on AWS with ECS Fargate and a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline

media.caption: Spree storefront running on ECS Fargate

projects.fullDescription: Cloud architecture project at ENSET Mohammedia: migrating a Spree e-commerce application to AWS as a fully containerised, production-ready deployment. The application runs on ECS Fargate with RDS PostgreSQL for persistence and ElastiCache Redis for caching, behind a segmented VPC. Delivery is automated through a Jenkins and Kubernetes CI/CD pipeline, and credentials are held in AWS Secrets Manager rather than in the codebase. Built in a team of three under the supervision of Prof. Kamal EL GUEMMAT.
features: Containerised application running serverlessly on ECS Fargate
Managed RDS PostgreSQL database and ElastiCache Redis caching layer
Segmented VPC network architecture isolating public and private tiers
IAM roles scoped to least-privilege principles
Credentials stored and rotated through AWS Secrets Manager
Automated CI/CD pipeline built on Jenkins and Kubernetes
Full technical report and architecture documentation

projects.title: AWS Zabbix Monitoring Infrastructure
projects.description: Containerised Zabbix platform on AWS supervising hybrid Linux and Windows fleets
projects.fullDescription: Cloud infrastructure project building a production-ready Zabbix monitoring system on AWS to supervise a hybrid Linux and Windows environment. The Zabbix 6.4 server runs containerised through Docker Compose on EC2, inside a purpose-built VPC with least-privilege security groups. Agent deployment on the monitored hosts is scripted rather than manual, and the repository ships two architectures: a single-subnet lab design for learning, and a production reference design with multiple availability zones, private subnets behind a NAT gateway, an Application Load Balancer and managed RDS. Code and documentation are public on GitHub alongside a full technical report.
features: Containerised Zabbix 6.4 server and PostgreSQL backend via Docker Compose
Purpose-built VPC with subnets, internet gateway, route tables and Network ACLs
Least-privilege security groups scoped to the Zabbix ports (10050/10051, 80/443)
Automated agent deployment scripts for both Linux and Windows hosts
Hybrid monitoring across Ubuntu 22.04 and Windows Server 2022 clients
Real-time monitoring dashboards and alerting
Documented production architecture with multi-AZ, NAT gateway, ALB and RDS
JSON export/import of the configuration for reproducible rebuilds
